name: smwpatches-16x16-hopping-flame-trail
title: 16x16 Hopping Flame Trail
description:
This patch is inspired by SMB3's Hopping Flames, which are 8x16 for the flame's tail, so I wanted to do something to increase the size of the flame remains left by the Hopping Flame.

The hijack does emulation of these 8x16 sprites using 16x16 to do the job easily!

Graphics included, credit not needed, Asar (and STEAR unless you want garbled graphics) is required!
